scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/web & npm run dev --workspace=apps/worker & wait
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.start: npm run start:web & npm run start:worker & wait
scripts.deploy:sony: npm ci && npm run db:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run build && PORT=26006 pm2 start npm --name 'filtradores-web' -- run start:web && pm2 start npm --name 'filtradores-worker' --kill-timeout 60000 -- run start:worker && pm2 save
scripts.redeploy:sony: git pull && npm ci && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run build && pm2 restart filtradores-web filtradores-worker
